approach: DolRecomp static recompilation of the game's PowerPC code, on Dolphin's hardware layer through ModernGekko
help: Testing on Mali and other non-Adreno GPUs
notes: Beta. Native Windows, Linux and Android (arm64) builds with widescreen (16:9 or any screen shape, ultrawide included), 60 fps, camera control, save states, auto-save, save import and backup, keyboard play and button mapping, quality-of-life options and the optional Dreamcast soundtrack (from the player's own Dreamcast disc); an Adreno GPU driver loader on Android. Full speed at 60 fps on a Retroid Pocket 5. Bring your own USA or European GameCube disc; no game data ships in any build.
